div.head: Leis Wl 14
div.ab: Si hom apeled auter de larrecin, et il seit franchs hom e puissed aver testimonie de lealted, se escundirad par plein serment.
Si home apeled altre de larcin, et il so[i]t francz home et il ait o[u]d ça’n erere testimonie de lealté, s’en escondirad per plein serment.
De appellatis ex furto. Si quis appellatur de furto et sit liber homo, si bone fame hucusque fuerit et testimonium bonum habuerit, purgabit se per iuramentum suum.
Si hom apeled auter de larrecin e il seit franchs hom e puissed aver testimonie de lealted, se escundirad par plein serment.
14. Wenn einer einen anderen auf Diebstahl verklagt, und [dies]er ein freier Mann ist und Legalitätszeugniss haben kann (bisher gehabt hat IL), so mag [Verklagt]er sich reinigen durch schlichten Eid.
14. If one accuses another of theft, and [th]is man is a free man and can have (has had hitherto IL) testimony of lawful standing, then the [accus]ed may clear himself by a simple oath.

If a man accuses another of theft and the latter is a free man and can produce witnesses to prove that he is entitled to the benefit of the law, he shall clear himself by the simple oath (of exculpation).
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 258–259 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 502–503, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
